hero.title: Authentic, slow-smoked *BBQ*
hero.lede: All our meat is smoked in house, with house-made sauces, almost-famous wings, burgers, tacos and bowls. Find us on The Alley in downtown Aiken, or on the river in North Augusta, with live music and the only waterfront dining in the area.

columns.title: North Augusta
items: Open Tuesdays when the GreenJackets play at home

items.text: The restaurant was great bar-b-que! Staff is amazing, friendly and go the extra mile! The restaurant was very clean and has a great atmosphere.
Ribs were great, very rich, but great. This place will definitely fill you up! Sauces were amazing too!
A fabulous selection of meats with accompanying choice of barbecue sauces. The view was fantastic. The hospitality from the staff excellent.

items.a: Yes. Every catering order is built around your event: birthdays, holiday parties, corporate events, weddings and more.

items.q: Can I host a party with you?
items.a: Yes, we can host your birthday, office function or other special occasion and take care of the details.

items.q: Is the meat smoked in house?
items.a: All of it, with house-made barbecue sauces.
